verdict.rationale: Requesty's analytics dashboard explicitly tracks cost, requests, tokens, cache savings, and latency across all models/providers in real time, and supports per-key spend caps and service accounts (non-human keys), enabling breakdown by key/user/team. missing for 10: no explicit evidence of a 'per-team' grouping/dashboard view or independent/hands-on corroboration of the analytics UI's granularity.
